meta.title: Madarao Mountain Resort
meta.description: 30 min from Iiyama Station — 100% natural "Madapow" powder and Japan's largest official tree-run network (15 courses).

transit.title:
30 minutes
from Iiyama Station.
transit.lead: About 30 minutes by car or bus from Hokuriku Shinkansen Iiyama Station — Madapow glades reachable in ~2h20 from Tokyo. Rent at Iiyama Station for loops to Madarao, Nozawa Onsen, and Lake Nojiri.
transit.imgAlt: Snowy countryside from the Hokuriku Shinkansen — winter trip from Iiyama to Madarao

primary.title: Madapow & 15 official tree runs
primary.lead: 100% natural "Madapow" snow — 15 in-bounds ungroomed tree runs (among Japan's largest). Thinned glades and managed entrances draw everyone from experts to families.
primary.imgAlt: Skier in deep powder tree run at Madarao — Madapow and snow-covered larch forest

secondary.title: After skiing, food & hot springs
secondary.lead: From Trois An Cinq apple pie on the slopes to Rudolf's stone-oven pizza in the pension village — après food and Madarao onsen are easy to plan for day trips or stays.

onsen.title:
Madarao onsen &
Madarao-no-Yu
onsen.lead: From alkaline Hoteibukuro baths at Madarao Kogen Hotel to day-use Madarao-no-Yu and Tangram's large bath — post-ski recovery is easy to design.
onsen.whisper: No onsen-town stroll like Nozawa — but slope-side hotels and day baths cover recovery well.
onsen.imgAlt: Steam from snow-view outdoor bath — Madarao highland onsen

madapow.title: Madapow & 15 official tree runs
madapow.body: 100% natural "Madapow" — 15 in-bounds tree runs including Powder Wave 2 (max 35°, 1,500 m), Ninja, and SAWA. With linked Tangram, the mountain pass covers 51 runs across both areas.

iiyama.title: Within 30 min of Iiyama Station
iiyama.body: ~30 min by bus or car from Hokuriku Shinkansen Iiyama Station — ~2h20 from Tokyo total. Rent at Iiyama for wider loops to Nozawa Onsen and Lake Nojiri.

family.title: Preschool lift tickets free
family.body: Preschool children ski free at Madarao — plus free snowboard beginner lessons (3× daily). Tangram next door does not match kids-free rules, so check before using a shared pass.
